back_blurb: From the goodbye at the door to the moment [Carer] walks back in, [Name] spends a whole day at [Nursery]: buses, puddles, songs and snack. And at home time, the door opens, just like always.
honesty_line: Illustrated from [Name]'s photo and checked by a person before print.
outfit: soft navy jumper, grey trousers, and a yellow coat
cover_art: [Name] in the story's key scene from spread 1 — face large and front-on; upper third calm for the title. Hall at home. [Name] tucks [Object] into a small backpack; [Carer] holds spare socks

title_page.spot: Small spot of [Object]. No child on this page.

anchor.description: [Object] on every spread it fits (10 of 14). Lock one nursery interior sheet (door, window, peg wall, carpet, book corner, table). Ada and [Teacher] drawn identically throughout. Spreads 2 and 14 use the same street.

must_not_show: adult looking sad at the window

spreads.text: Morning. [Name] and [Carer] pack the nursery bag. Spare socks. A water bottle. And [Object]. "[Object] comes too," says [Name].
spreads.setting: Hall at home. [Name] tucks [Object] into a small backpack
spreads.art: Hall at home. [Name] tucks [Object] into a small backpack; [Carer] holds spare socks
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Out of the front door. Along the same pavement as always. Past the postbox. Past the big tree. And here is [Nursery].
spreads.setting: Terraced street, postbox, big tree. [Name] holds [Carer]'s hand
spreads.art: Terraced street, postbox, big tree. [Name] holds [Carer]'s hand; [Object] peeks from the bag
spreads.calm_zone_note: Sky — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Teacher] is at the door. Time for the goodbye. Two kisses. One big hug. "I always come back at home time," says [Carer].
spreads.setting: Nursery front door. [Teacher] smiles in the doorway
spreads.art: Nursery front door. [Teacher] smiles in the doorway; [Carer] crouches for the hug
spreads.calm_zone_note: Above the door — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Carer] goes. [Name] waves at the window, and [Carer] waves back. [Teacher] holds [Name]'s hand. "[Carer] always comes back at home time."
spreads.art: Inside by the window. [Name] waves; [Carer], outside, waves back smiling; [Teacher] holds [Name]'s hand
spreads.anchor: [Object] in the bag on the floor
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper wall — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Coat on the peg. [Name]'s peg has [Name]'s own picture on it. Wellies on the rack. Bag in the tray.
spreads.setting: Peg wall. [Name] hangs a coat on a peg marked with a small picture (no letters)
spreads.art: Peg wall. [Name] hangs a coat on a peg marked with a small picture (no letters); wellies on the rack
spreads.anchor: [Object] peeking from the bag on the tray
spreads.calm_zone_note: Above the pegs — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Play time! A girl called Ada has the red bus. [Name] has the blue bus. Brrm, brrm. They swap. Brrm, brrm.
spreads.setting: Play area. [Name] and Ada swap a red and a blue toy bus, both grinning
spreads.art: Play area. [Name] and Ada swap a red and a blue toy bus, both grinning
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Morning snack at the little table. Toast and banana. [Name] sits next to Ada. Munch, munch, munch. Ada has a banana moustache!
spreads.setting: Little table, toast and banana. Ada has a banana smear on her lip
spreads.art: Little table, toast and banana. Ada has a banana smear on her lip; [Name] laughs
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Outside time. It's raining! Wellies on. [Name] finds the biggest puddle. "Ada! Come and splash!" Splash goes [Name]. Splash goes Ada. [Teacher] laughs.
spreads.setting: Nursery garden in the rain, wellies and raincoats. [Name] beckons Ada towards a big puddle
spreads.art: Nursery garden in the rain, wellies and raincoats. [Name] beckons Ada towards a big puddle; both mid-splash; [Teacher] laughing behind
spreads.calm_zone_note: Grey sky — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Name] misses [Carer]. [Teacher] sits close. "You miss [Carer]," says [Teacher]. "I know. [Carer] comes back at home time." [Name] holds [Object] close.
spreads.setting: Quiet corner. [Teacher] sits close beside [Name] at child height
spreads.art: Quiet corner. [Teacher] sits close beside [Name] at child height; [Name] thoughtful, a little sad but calm, holding [Object] close. No tears, no window
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Song time on the carpet. Everyone sits in a circle. [Name] watches first. Then comes a bit [Name] knows. Clap, clap! [Name] joins in.
spreads.setting: Carpet circle. [Name] sits a little back, watching, then clapping along with a small smile
spreads.art: Carpet circle. [Name] sits a little back, watching, then clapping along with a small smile; other children around
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Quiet time. [Name] curls up in the cosy corner with [Object] and a picture book. The room goes still. Shhh.
spreads.setting: Cosy book corner with cushions. [Name] curled up with [Object] and an open picture book (no readable text)
spreads.art: Cosy book corner with cushions. [Name] curled up with [Object] and an open picture book (no readable text); face lit
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper half — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Afternoon snack! Crackers and apple. [Name] looks at the door. Coats on soon. Nearly home time. Crunch, crunch, crunch. Last crumb!
spreads.art: Little table, crackers and apple; coats visible on the pegs behind. [Name] glances towards the door
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: The door opens. Who is it? It's [Carer]! [Name] runs. Big hug. "You came back!" "I always come back," says [Carer].
spreads.art: Door opens; [Carer] in the doorway; [Name] runs into a hug, face visible over [Carer]'s shoulder
spreads.calm_zone_note: Above the door — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Walking home, [Name] tells [Carer] about Ada and the big puddle. Past the big tree. Past the postbox. And there is home.
spreads.setting: The same street as spread 2, late-afternoon light: big tree, postbox, then the family's front door. [Name] talks, arms wide
spreads.art: The same street as spread 2, late-afternoon light: big tree, postbox, then the family's front door. [Name] talks, arms wide; [Carer] listens, carrying the bag
spreads.calm_zone_note: Sky — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

parent_spread.you_could_say: "I always come back at home time."
parent_spread.try_together: "Who could you ask for a hug or help at nursery?"
parent_spread.in_real_life: Choose a short goodbye you can repeat. It might be two kisses and a big hug, like in the story. Tell [Name] who is coming back, and when.
parent_spread.read_it_again: Read this story a few nights in a row, and once more just before the day itself.
